No orbital basis is specified or invented for xTB; functional, basis, dispersion, and integration_grid are left unset because they are not required by the GFN2-xTB method. No coordinates, native engine input, or shell commands were authored, and no execution is requested. Readiness is blocked_unverified_setting: no case-bound read-only registry inspection tool was available in this session, so the host-registered status of the required settings (gfn_version, solvent_model, solvent_id) could not be confirmed as exact_registered. The reported literals (GFN2, ALPB, water) are retained verbatim and are not substituted with familiar values.
